boundaries.healthConsent: Strict privacy boundary: Sensitive health records require explicit self-consent under Decree 13.
boundaries.statutoryDeletion: Statutory Customer Right: Data subject deletion request cannot be executed by staff.
boundaries.frontDeskOnly: Operational integrity: Physical identification check and key handover restricted to Front Desk.
boundaries.frontDeskCheckout: Financial accountability: Cashier and key return operations belong strictly to Front Desk.
boundaries.therapistHealthOnly: Data minimization (BR-03): Clinical health notes accessible ONLY by assigned treating therapists.
boundaries.fnbDietaryOnly: Data minimization (BR-03): Kitchen staff sees allergy tags only; clinical diagnoses strictly withheld.
boundaries.adminOnly: Security governance: RBAC matrix configuration reserved strictly for System Administrator.
boundaries.delegationAdminOnly: Privilege escalation protection: Delegation powers cannot be sub-delegated or self-assigned.
boundaries.auditAdminOnly: Accountability: Audit trail inspection reserved exclusively for System Administrator.
